Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Lubomira Hradok
Clan: Nosferatu antitribu (group 5)
Capacity: 3
Disciplines: OBF
Sabbat. Black Hand: If Lubomira successfully bleeds a Methuselah who controls a ready titled vampire, she does not untap as normal during her next untap phase.

It might be me, or does her text say:

(A)
Lubomira Hradok
Sabbat. Black Hand: If Lubomira successfully bleeds a Methuselah who controls a ready titled vampire, Lubomira does not untap as normal during your next untap phase.

or
(B)

Lubomira Hradok
Sabbat. Black Hand: If Lubomira successfully bleeds a Methuselah who controls a ready titled vampire, titled vampire does not untap as normal during her next untap phase.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: (A). Vampires are "he"s in the Rulebook. (B) would have been "choose one of that player's titled vampires: that vampire doesn't untapped during his or her controller's next untapped phase".

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
She for Methuselah and he for vampires only stands for the rulebook

> * Throughout this rulebook, references to players (Methuselahs) will be feminine ("she" and "her"), while references to minions (characters represented in the game) will be masculine ("he" and "his"). These pronouns are not intended to identify gender; this is merely a useful method to avoid both cumbersome "he or she" constructions and ambiguity.
>
The "she" on Lubomira is Lubomira herself. As Pascal says, wording would have been different otherwise (at least with "he or she")

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
